claims.statement: Self-contained exploratory-v1 fixed-Q / recover-P (`e(P, Q) -> P`) reduction via two calibrated gamma_0-blinded G_T virtual logarithms (exact lambda-cancellation without V(g_0) or a third descent) in (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS (C = 20,000 pure baseline scalar ARMv8.0-A integer instructions/F_p12 mul; simd=0, zero LSE/NEON/SVE/DC ZVA/fp64), combining 1,000,000-draw r_ab=0.83 Zero-Slice 1-Pass Band-2 (W_SB=16, oid<2^56, 62b direct apply) + P_min=32 KH=0.08 3-prime Radix-4 Lazy Shoup NTT Stage-B + Ordered Norms collection (2^109.261632 u, replay_a_tables 2^104.738608 u), 1-dense (2^63.668 B < 2^64 B) + 16-matrix-shard (2^62.337 B < 2^64 B each, priced streaming c_stream_mat=204.0 Ir/row) 4-vec 4-col LA (2^107.739795 u, 1.45x 2^25 caps, zero TABM), and exact 384-mesh Q(zeta_15) uncapped dsieve16 + BOUND_CELL yield-certificate + q15_retain16 + NegBin(r=0.5/1.0) lazy descent with BOOT_RELS=18 whole-ball renewal boot (two_log_exp <= 2^103.175 u, proved input-uniform PAIR_SETUP=2^35.2, LLL_NODE=2^40.0, LLL_BOOT=2^46.5), achieving opened-run expected work E[W_run] <= 2^109.7564 u behind hard meter T_run = 2^123 u (every run W <= 2^123 + 2^66 u) with opened-run success >= 0.99905 (even at +10% meter sensitivity), and gated cold-run expected work E[W] <= 2^108.399317240806 u with cold success >= 0.39. No prior verdict or score is a premise.
